regions.name: Nairobi and Central

state_distinguishers.Nairobi: Largest East African city, specific Nairobi matatu infrastructure, modern CBD
state_distinguishers.Central_Kenya: Tea and coffee plantations, very green highlands, Mount Kenya backdrop

regions.route_sign_clues: A2, A3 major routes from Nairobi.
regions.gemini_hint: Modern East African city = Nairobi. Tea plantation rows on green hills = Central Kenya. Mount Kenya snow peak visible = Central Kenya confirmed.
common_false_positives: Green highlands — also in Uganda and Rwanda

regions.name: Rift Valley

state_distinguishers.Nakuru_area: Lake Nakuru flamingos, Rift Valley escarpment visible
state_distinguishers.Turkana: Extremely arid, Lake Turkana jade sea visible, most remote northern region

regions.gemini_hint: Dramatic escarpment walls = Rift Valley. Pink flamingos on lake = Nakuru. Extremely arid jade-colored lake = Turkana.
common_false_positives: Acacia savanna — shared across East Africa

regions.name: Coast Province

state_distinguishers.Mombasa: Island city infrastructure, Mombasa Old Town Swahili architecture, port city feel
state_distinguishers.Lamu: Most preserved Swahili town, no cars on island, very traditional feel

regions.gemini_hint: Swahili coral stone architecture = Kenya or Tanzania coast. Mombasa port infrastructure = Mombasa confirmed. No vehicles + traditional Swahili = Lamu.
common_false_positives: Coastal tropical — could be Tanzania coast

regions.name: Western and Nyanza
visual_identifiers: lush green vegetation unlike dry Kenya

state_distinguishers.Kisumu: Lake Victoria port city, specific Kisumu lakeside infrastructure
state_distinguishers.Kakamega: Kakamega rainforest area, sugarcane fields, most forested part of Kenya

regions.gemini_hint: Lake Victoria visible = Western Kenya, Uganda, or Tanzania. Sugarcane fields = Kakamega. Lush green unlike typical Kenya = Western Kenya confirmed.
common_false_positives: Lake Victoria shore — also in Uganda and Tanzania
